blocks.text: INGLEWOOD, California— Brice Sensabaugh scored a season-high 40 points, including 25 in the fourth quarter, and the Utah Jazz beat the Los Angeles Clippers 132-107 on Tuesday night for just their second victory of the NBA season. Sensabaugh sparked Utah’s 44-point fourth quarter and Keyonte George added 30 points and 11 assists for the Jazz, who improved to 2-13 with their first win since beating New Orleans on Oct. 23 in their second game of the season. Utah had been 0-6 on the road. NBA preview: Jazz enter new season with fresh additions, much to prove Sensabaugh came off the bench […]...
